display_long_description:
Visit Alaska is an immersive virtual reality experience filmed entirely in breathtaking 360° 3D.

The journeys central point is the map. With a simple point-and-click, you can “travel” instantly to mesmerizing destinations such as the crevasse-filled Root Glacier Trail, the glacier-carved Denali Teklanika River, the vibrant Fairbanks Pioneer Park and Pioneer Museum, or the majestic Aialik Glacier in Kenai Fjords National Park. 
[media]
Each site was captured on location, providing an authentically cinematic view of Alaska’s natural wonders and historical treasures. From traveling on a boat among glacial icebergs to walking through century-old mining towns, the app invites users to experience every vista and story in rich spatial 3D depth.
[media]
Every location features optional multi-language audio guides that combine cultural, natural, and historical storytelling. Alternatively, you can switch to ambient mode and enjoy each scene accompanied by soothing background music or the raw, natural soundscape of Alaska’s winds, waterfalls, and wildlife.
[media]
Accessibility is at the heart of the app’s design. With its auto-move feature, users of all ages and abilities—including seniors.
[media]
Whether you are gazing at tidewater glaciers calving into icy fjords, reliving Alaska’s gold rush past, or simply soaking in the peace of its untouched wilderness, Visit Alaska VR offers an extraordinary way to experience America’s last frontier—immersive, inclusive, and unforgettable.
[media]
